content: Do not collect stones and build a fortress of pride; the moment the breath departs, you depart alone and empty-handed.
author: Kabir
explanation: Every possession we fight and scheme for remains behind when the final breath leaves the body. The only true wealth is the love and spiritual awareness we realized within.
practicalInsight: De-clutter your living or work space today. Give away something valuable to someone in genuine need.
reflectionPrompt: What possession am I hoarding as if I could carry it beyond the grave?
